advancements.over_the_rainbow.sent_to_sh: Wipe an entity off the face of the earth.
Midnight on a full moon would be the best time to do it, any other time the risks are... immense.\
*Can the might of gods truly be imitated?*
book.spectrum.guidebook.banishment_curse:
The energy of a Spectral Shard in such a small area got me thinking: *what if it was compacted?*\
\
Naturally, this would be too explosive for me to even think of doing at home, but an enchantment would be able to capture the energy nicely!

Makes any enemy hit disappear, at the loss of their loot.\
\
Max Level: 1\
Applicable to all tools.

This enchantment is... odd, to say the least.\
\
Anything I hit with it disappears without a trace, so naturally I named it "Curse of Banishment".\
\
I do not know where they go, *which is kind of scary when I stop to think about it.*\
\
*I should be* ***really*** *careful around this one.*
book.spectrum.guidebook.barrage.page0.te:
While gazing into my new creation, I wondered how to make use of it. I believe I have an answer: this enchantment.\
\
Using the repetitive properties of Pure Echo and the unfettered power of the Spectral Shards, I can double the arrows shot with my crossbow!\
\
It *does* sacrifice some accuracy, but it's a sacrifice worth making.
book.spectrum.guidebook.barrage.page1.te:
Doubles the base arrows fired per volley, at the cost of accuracy.\
\
Max Level: 1\
Applicable to Crossbows.\
Mutually exclusive with Multishot and Sniping.
book.spectrum.guidebook.the_conservatory:
My lungs are being shredded more with every breath; the air here is as toxic as it is debilitating.\
\
At any given moment my body is vivisected almost as quickly as it is put back together.\
\
I can only look downwards, as to look in any other direction is to stare at that which wants to gouge my eyes out.

After an eternity, I had finally come to my senses. I looked around and I was... fine? Whatever, more important questions: where am I and how do I get back?\
\
Looking further I noticed a small rift behind me, *how convenient*.\
\
Despite me recovering, every second that passes here makes the clamp around my head tighten.\
*I shouldn't be here - not yet*.
book.spectrum.guidebook.memories.page3.t:
Aha! It seems that Spectral Shards are strong enough to resurrect creatures of immense strength!\
\
*A torturous endeavor for the remembered mob, I'm sure.*\
*It's probably best if I don't use this for weaker mobs...*
book.spectrum.guidebook.monstrosity.page:
\
\
Despite me ***knowing*** this would go horrifically wrong, I still decided to go through with it. The result?

Static. Upon it hatching, I saw nothing except **blinding** static that blurred my vision to the point of blindness.\
\
Then, simultaneously, a torrent of words that were hotter than the sun began to flood and imprint on my mind; each word conflicting with the last as a testament to this "creature"'s paradoxical nature.\
\
*And yet, I saw no "life" where it hatched; only the wounds in the earth it left.*

These visions were the least of my worries though, as when it wasn't running like a coward, it was chewing through my armor as if it didn't even exist! It mercilessly beat me to a ***pulp***, and yet through the astronomical odds I was able to land a singular lucky hit.\
\
I couldn't see the carcass, but I could see the *pitch black* blood it spilled that corrupted the ground it ran upon.\
*Was this... ****thing**** the cause of the Langasts? Am I going too far? So many questions...*
book.spectrum.guidebook.potion_workshop_:
A volatile and erratic reagent, it seems to randomly do some of the following:\
- makes the potion completely unidentifiable
- randomizes the potion's color
- adds anywhere from 0 to 2 positive or negative effects


*mistakes were made in learning what this does*
book.spectrum.guidebook.spectral_shard.p:
My first attempt to reach for the stars - long, long ago - was not too successful.\
\
Looking back, I can only laugh at how simple-minded I was. I've learned a lot and came a long way.\
*Now I am here. Take 2, here we go.*
*The feeling of perfection, this time for real*.
book.spectrum.guidebook.spirit_sallow.pa:
A harrowing thought crossed my mind, one I cannot fight. Although I've acted on impulse in the past, this feels more crushing than those atrocities combined. \
\
*It's only a sapling. It's only a sapling. It's only a sapling.*

Where did this name come from? I don't know - perhaps it's inspiration from the same powers that let me create these... abhorrences.\
\
The sapling, itself, doesn't do much of anything *other than creep me out*.\
Even the act of holding it feels wrong...

In a word: mesmerising. The center trades rings for lights similar to ones I've seen in Preservation Ruins!\
\
*While easy to take the log, stripping bark seems like a* ***much*** *harder endeavor.*

Infusing the sapling with a Spectral Shard caused a heart to grow!\
It's reminiscent of Azurite in color, water in motion, and Light Blue in peace.\
\
*It's use, however, is lost on me.*
Weeping Gala leaves if they shed like a pack of wolves, though pretty in small amounts.
Disgusting. Revolting. Destroy on sight, if not for the sanctity of the world, then for the sanctity of my eyes.
spectrum.rei.potion_workshop_reacting.sp:
Extremely volatile.\
Even perfection has it's faults.
